svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The nine keys a guardrail receipt returns, one to a row, each with what fills it. Two are digests, over the input bytes and over the returned text. Three are counts: the length of the input, the length of what came back, and how many times each rule fired. Two are names: which operation ran, and what it acted on, trimmed to a path or a program name. One is a clock stamp. The last is metadata, and its row is accented, because the caller fills it and nothing redacts what goes in.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: What a guardrail receipt records, and what it leaves out

g.text: Stamped in UTC to the second when the receipt is built. Two
runs over the same input differ here and nowhere else.

g.text: The raw bytes as they arrived, before any rule ran. It identifies
the input without keeping any of it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Whatever the caller passed, stored as given. No rule is applied
to it, so this is the one field a secret can be written into.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Which path built this: read, write, write.dry_run, fetch, or exec.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: How long the input was. A length, never the content behind it.

g.text: How long the returned text is. It moves away from raw_bytes
when a replacement is a different length than what it replaced.

g.text: The returned text, digested. Running the same policy over the

g.text: Each rule that fired, and how many times. Rule names only, so a
count of seven says nothing about what the seven were.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The file path, or the scheme, host and path of a URL, or the base
name of a program. Arguments and query strings are dropped

svg.text: The receipt is built from the input and the redacted output together, which is how it can say how much changed without keeping what changed.
Everything drawn here is either a hash, a count, or a name the tool trimmed itself. The exception is metadata, which is stored exactly as it was
